description:
“I had a husband! And he was your employee!”    

“So?”    

Instead of answering, the man grabbed her hands and pinned them down. His dark eyes trapped Eunwoo, and in that moment, forgotten memories came rushing back. Looking back, he had always looked at her that way - with a gaze that stripped her bare, as if he wanted her from the very start. Knowing exactly what that look meant, she still crossed the line with him. And that night, Eunwoo finally realizes the weight of the sin she committed… using her lost memories as an excuse, she became involved with her husband’s boss.
